summary: Table Trac, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on November 6, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.02 per share on the common stock (OTCQX: TBTC). The dividend is payable December 11, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business on November 27, 2026; no advisor or board recommendation beyond the declaration was disclosed. The press release cites recurring software, maintenance and service revenue as support for continued shareholder returns. Watch for dividend sustainability against recurring-revenue trends and any shift in capital-return cadence.
